title: Contracts I
description: Contracts I, Weeks 1–9 (Epstein, Markell & Ponoroff, Making and Doing Deals, 7th ed.). Covers whether there is an enforceable agreement, the objective theory of assent, offers and their termination, options and firm offers, methods of acceptance and silence, the mirror-image rule and UCC § 2-207, misunderstanding, indefiniteness and letters of intent, consideration, modification, promissory estoppel, the statute of frauds, duress, and misrepresentation.

Contracts_I_Condensed_Outline.docx.title: Contracts I Outline
Contracts_I_Condensed_Outline.docx.description: Condensed exam outline of Weeks 1–9 on the Fall 2026 syllabus. Part I covers formation: enforceable agreements and which law governs, objective assent and implied-in-fact contracts, offers, termination of the power of acceptance, irrevocable offers, acceptance and silence, the mirror-image rule and the battle of the forms, misunderstanding, and indefiniteness. Part II covers consideration, modification, and promissory estoppel. Part III covers the statute of frauds, duress, and misrepresentation. Rule and tip boxes throughout, and a card for every assigned case plus slide references.

Contracts_I_Bar_Questions.html.title: Contracts I Bar Questions
Contracts_I_Bar_Questions.html.description: 266 bar-style multiple-choice questions covering every rule, case, and tip in the Weeks 1–9 outline, across 16 topics from enforceable agreements and the objective theory through offers, termination, irrevocable offers, acceptance and silence, the battle of the forms, misunderstanding, indefiniteness, consideration, modification, promissory estoppel, the Statute of Frauds, duress, and misrepresentation, plus a set of integrated multi-issue problems. Each question sets out new facts, and every answer choice has its own explanation. Variations change one fact to test whether the result changes. Filter by topic, shuffle the questions or answers, retry the ones you missed, and use the coverage map to find the questions for any outline item.

Contracts_I_Master_Outline.docx.description: Full-semester master outline (Weeks 1–14), kept off the public site. Use it as the reference when making questions, flowcharts, and flashcards for this subject.
